entries.title: Zephaniah 1 — Chapter Introduction
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the Lord. Ps 11:4; 115:3; 132:13,14; Isa 6:1; 66:1,6; Jon 2:4,7; Eph 2:21,22 let all the earth keep silence before him. Heb. be silent allthe earth before him. Ps 46:10; 76:8,9; Zep 1:7; Zec 2:13

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The time when Zephaniah prophesied. 2 God's severe judgments against Judah.

word. Eze 1:3; Ho 1:1; 2Ti 3:16; 2Pe 1:19 in the days. 2Ki 22:1-23:37; 2Ch 34:1-35:27; Jer 1:2; 25:3

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will, etc. Heb. By taking away I will make an end.utterly. 2Ki 22:16,17; 2Ch 36:21; Isa 6:11; Jer 6:8,9; 24:8-10; 34:22; 36:29 Eze 33:27-29; Mic 7:13 land. Heb. face of the land.

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: consume man. Jer 4:23-29; 12:4; Ho 4:3 stumbling-blocks. or, idols. Isa 27:9; Eze 7:19; 14:3-7; 44:12; Ho 14:3,8; Mic 5:11-14 Zec 13:2; Mt 23:39; Re 2:14 and I. Eze 14:13-21; 15:6-8

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: stretch. Ex 15:12; 2Ki 21:13; Isa 14:26,27 the remnant. "Fulfilled." 2Ki 23:4,5; 2Ch 34:4 the Chemarims. Ho 10:5; *marg:

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: worship. 2Ki 23:12; Jer 19:13; 32:29 and them. 1Ki 18:21; 2Ki 17:33,41; Mt 6:24 and that. De 10:20; Isa 48:1; Jer 4:2; Ho 4:15 by the Lord. or, to the Lord. Isa 44:5; 45:23; Ro 14:11 swear by. Jos 23:7 Malcham. 1Ki 11:33 Milcom. Am 5:26 Moloch.

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
those.Or, "that leap over the threshold," by which is probably meant the Philistines, who, after the time that Dagon fell before the ark and was broken on the threshold, leaped over it when entering his temple.

leap. 1Sa 5:5 which. 1Sa 2:15,16; 2Ki 5:20-27; Ne 5:15; Pr 29:12; Ac 16:19

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: in. 7,15; Jer 39:2 the noise. Isa 22:4,5; 59:11; Jer 4:19-21,31; Am 8:3 the fish gate. 2Ch 33:14; Ne 3:3 the second. 2Ki 22:14; 2Ch 32:22 from. 2Sa 5:7,9; 2Ch 3:1

entries.title: Zephaniah 1:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: that I. Jer 16:16,17; Am 9:1-3; Ob 1:6 the men. Jer 48:11; Am 6:1; Re 2:23 settled. Heb. curded, or thickened. The Lord. Job 21:15; Ps 10:11-13; 14:1; 94:7; Isa 5:19; Jer 10:5; Eze 8:12; 9:9 Mal 3:14,15; 2Pe 3:4
